'''Nagarreken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he served on [[Carrick Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]] where he sold equipment. He wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|tattered ritualists robes]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nagarreken first appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''. In the game he served as an equipment vendor for the [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] Republic flashpoints, only accepting relics from those flashpoints as currency.
